text:
Situation: Clindamycin in 5 percent dextrose has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-03-21 and remains current as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 43 months. The listing covers Baxter Healthcare, Pfizer Inc., Sagent Pharmaceuticals, and Sandoz Inc., all with current status. Corvale East has 11 days on hand, Corvale General has 15 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 19 days at current usage rates.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2023-03-21. The listing remains current as of 2026-10-21 for Baxter Healthcare, Pfizer Inc., Sagent Pharmaceuticals, and Sandoz Inc. Sandoz's label names InfoRLife SA as the manufacturing plant, but the plant is not placed in our records.

Our position: Supply is critically low at Corvale East and constrained at Corvale General. Alternative suppliers not on FDA's shortage list exist and use the same plant identified on Sandoz's label.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Civica, Inc. (not on FDA shortage list; uses InfoRLife SA). Requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Henry Schein, Inc., Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC, and ProPharma Distribution as secondary sources (none on FDA shortage list today). Requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to allocate existing stock to Corvale East first. Requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Waiting for current listed manufacturers to resolve the shortage given 43-month duration.
